NOUGHTVAULT  //  PATTERN · TEPI

The tepi

The 8 mm ruled border, inside a 14 mm plain hem. It carries 26 cecek a side — one per punch in the DC53 alphabet. Like the 24 shoots, it is ornament that happens to count: it costs one instruction to the shop, it is never mentioned in a listing, and it is the detail that makes the object read as designed rather than sourced.

26 cecek a sideshown at 300 mm of a 306 mm run
